empty.title: Add your first repository
empty.dropHint: You can also drag a folder onto this window.

actions.addDescription: Choose a folder on this computer that already uses Git.
actions.cloneDescription: Copy a repository from a URL, such as one on GitHub or GitLab.
actions.createDescription: Start a new project in an empty folder.

overview.missingBody: It may have been moved, renamed, or deleted.

add.title: Add existing repository
add.initOffer: Create a repository in this folder instead?

clone.title: Clone repository
clone.urlHint: HTTPS or SSH, for example https://github.com/owner/repo.git
clone.name: Folder name
clone.noAccountHint: The clone signs in the way your Git is set up (credential helper or a prompt).
clone.accountHint: The clone signs in as @{{login}} over HTTPS, and the repository keeps using this account.
clone.sshHint: This URL uses SSH: the clone uses your SSH keys, and the repository keeps the account for pull requests.

author.title: Choose the commit author
author.mismatch: Commits here would be by {{email}}, which isn't on @{{login}}, so GitHub won't link them to the account. Which author should this repository use?
author.missing: Git has no author email for this repository yet. Which of @{{login}}'s addresses should it use?
author.noreplyHint: Keeps your real address out of commits
author.keepHint: Your Git settings stay as they are. You can change this later from the author line.

openIn.title: Where should {{name}} open?
openIn.body: A new window keeps this window's repository open.
openIn.rememberHint: You can change this in Settings > General.
